Endpoint change: POST /v2/exports becomes POST /v3/jobs/export.

Deprecated field: callback_url is replaced by webhook.destination_url.
Safe rollout: send X-Export-Dry-Run: true for the first 24 hours.
Distractor: Import API v3 still accepts UUIDv4 keys until 2027.

Distractor: low-risk chatbots keep analytics for 13 months.
